name: Immich share links
description: Lets anyone open the albums and photos you share from Immich, at their own address, while Immich itself stays behind your login. Read-only; it only passes through what you've shared.
compose:
services:
  immich-public-proxy:
    image: alangrainger/immich-public-proxy:latest
    container_name: immich-public-proxy
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3000"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: {PUBLIC_URL}
      IMMICH_URL: http://host.docker.internal:{IMMICH_PORT}
    healthcheck:
      test: curl -sf -m 4 http://localhost:3000/share/healthcheck -o /dev/null || exit 1
      start_period: 10s
      timeout: 5s
